meta.name: web-security-auditor
meta.description: Aggregate SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets, API, frontend, and backend security checks into one report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多种安全检测结果汇总成一份报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要整合多个安全工具的输出并生成统一报告
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate multiple security scan results into one report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to consolidate outputs from various security tools into a single report

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动对项目进行 Web 安全审计，包括静态代码分析、依赖扫描、动态测试、密钥检测、前后端和 API 安全检查，并生成一份 JSON 格式的安全报告。
howto.when: 当你在 Web 项目开发的安全阶段，或要求 Claude 进行安全审查时触发。

say.text: 请对我的项目做一次完整的安全审计。
say.note: Claude 会执行所有安全检查并生成报告。

say.text: 检查这个项目的依赖有没有已知漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会运行 SCA 扫描。

say.text: 扫描代码中的硬编码密钥。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs a web security audit including static analysis, dependency scanning, dynamic testing, secret detection, frontend/backend and API checks, and generates a JSON security report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are in the security phase of web development or ask Claude to perform a security review.

say_en.text: Run a full security audit on my project.
say_en.note: Claude will execute all checks and generate a report.

say_en.text: Check this project's dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
Scan the code for hardcoded secrets.
say_en.note: Claude will run Gitleaks and TruffleHog.
